sample_selection: Explanatory, outcome-stratified examples among BTC/ETH/LPT; not a representative/random sample. Normal examples >=2025, both sides noncensored stop/target and holding<=72h. Prefer class-median delay, avoid extreme R. Fixed LPT screenshot event and latest cancellation cases. BTC long double-loss adds directional coverage.
panels: 1H context with signal/entries/exits and relevant weekly levels
5m close-computed EMA20/50 flip and entry detail
data_policy: Reuse frozen fills; full source history only to compute continuous EMA and OHLC; never rerun PnL. Freeze displayed candles/EMA and provenance by source size/mtime, no input hashes.
